name: DINO ViT Feature Extraction
aliases: Self-Supervised ViT Feature Extraction for Transfer Functions
definition: A pre-processing step that extracts a 3D feature volume F from volumetric data V using a self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) to provide semantic features for segmentation, overcoming the locality of traditional intensity-based features.
summary: DINO ViT Feature Extraction defines volume rendering transfer functions using frozen self-supervised Vision Transformer features to provide semantic context without per-volume training.
